procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
FRA 3252 was represented by Satine Berenger.
GBR 6682 was represented by Elizabeth Hudson.
Stéphanie Barbarin, team leader of FRA 3252, attended the hearing as an observer.
Kate Dairs, team leader of GBR 6682, attended the hearing as an observer.
Baptiste Verniest, member of the international jury, attended the hearing as interpreter for FRA 3252.
facts: Race 7, 5 knots of wind, flat water, about 150m from mark 1.
FRA 3252 was sailing on starboard and GBR 6682 on port, on converging courses.
As she was about half a boat length from GBR 6682, FRA 3252 bore away and crossed just behind the rudder of GBR 6682 then resumed her course.
conclusions: GBR 6682 on port tack failed to keep clear of FRA 3252 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
